name: epaper-automation
description: A Python based Github Actions Workflow to automate deliveries of e-newspapers using Github Pages to Host Content

paragraphs: Pulls the Editorial page out of today's The Hindu and Indian Express e-papers, publishes it to a small static site, and posts the link to Discord — the single page as a PDF, plus (for The Hindu) each main article cropped out as its own image. Runs on a GitHub Actions cron, no server to maintain.

The original primary source was preppyq.in, a static WordPress page listing direct PDF links for The Hindu. It went behind a paywall: the table's links now point at rzp.io Razorpay payment pages instead of PDFs. That failed silently — the scraper downloaded the payment page's HTML, found no Editorial text in it, and recorded the day as skippednotpublished, so the workflow kept reporting success while producing nothing. Removed entirely rather than kept as a fallback; a source that fails by looking like a quiet no-op is worse than no source.

requirements.text: One hand-patch on top of the vendored files: PDF.js's viewer.mjs hardcodes a same-origin check (validateFileURL) that only exempts Mozilla's own mozilla.github.io demo from loading a different-origin file via ?file= — any other self-hosted deployment gets silently blocked (an empty viewer, no console-visible network failure, since it throws before ever fetching).
